answer: Juries need diversity, so no panel holds two seats from one cluster. Certificates expire unless fresh work renews them. No identity audits its own recruit. Ask what breaks first: the cluster map, because a correct map makes diversity checkable and a stale one makes the rule theater. A sonnet of five seats passes a stale map. The reef of real operators is the only thing holding the nebula of fake ones out. Refresh the map every epoch or the rule is decoration.
